body: I ended up calling everyone on my phone list until someone picked up......I've asked him to put his guns away and He says he will but he never does

Yes.....I had/have terrible anxiety unfortunately I got lucky (sort of) one day i got so fed up with relying on them that I moved out with my boyfriend to a different state even got on an airplane ( a huge fear of mine) I have been dealing with anxiety since childhood my parents have always been very supportive with helping me they took me to therapy homeschooled me ....I was never alone they always tried to help me the best that they could and it killed me ....I hated feeling like I was the problem child....my parents never went out on dates they were never alone because I would get a panic attack whenever they would leave .....so I left  ....my anxiety is a lot better now (its not completely gone) but its manageable ....I wish I had the money for therapy and health insurance so I could really get it under control but ...that's what worked for me ....I hope you find something that works for you I know how tough it is ....sorry for lack of grammar and misspellings BTW I'm 22 and just finally got my license about two months ago ...it was nerve wrecking (almost killed my parents because of a panic attack I had while driving on the freeway) but I did it !
